display.title: Take Hashem Along: A Summer Vacation Message
display.summary_short: Uncle Yossi reminds children to take Hashem along on summer vacation: daven, learn and give tzedakah every day, and share Torah and mitzvos with the new people you meet.
display.summary_long: A short talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, broadcast as summer vacation began in 1989. Uncle Yossi explains that to enjoy a happy and healthy summer we must include Hashem in our daily plans: pack a siddur, Chumash and Tehillim, daven and learn every day, and give tzedakah. Just as the body needs vitamins, the neshamah needs its own healthy food. Children should bring along their Tzivos Hashem mitzvah charts. Summer travel brings new friends and new places, so it is a special chance for Ahavas Yisroel: ask why Hashem let you meet each person, and share Torah and mitzvos with them. Every mitzvah a friend does because of you earns you a mitzvah too, tipping the scale toward a sweet new year when Tishrei comes. The talk ends with the Rebbe's teaching that the coming year 5750 will be a year of miracles, the greatest being the coming of Moshiach.
display.lesson: Put Hashem at the top of your summer plans, and use every new meeting to share Torah and mitzvos.

date.note: Cut from episode 382 (1989-06-20); the talk refers to the coming year 5750.

sources_cited.note: 5750 (Tav-Shin-Nun) stands for 'Tihyeh Shnas Nissim', a year of miracles.
